title: [v6.1] Forces cgroupfs on WSL to fix the regression with WSL v3
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

Cherry-picked 3 commits from #29883

```
Mention in docs that cgroupfs doesn't work in rootless mode

Signed-off-by: Mario Loriedo <mario.loriedo@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit 0aad7c6601028582ecf1c569c3e0e1c2d9738eb3)
```

```
Fix the regression on WSL v3: force using cgroufs

Fixes #29749

It's the same fix as podman-container-tools/podman-machine-os#319 but
this PR fixes existing machines, the ones that have been created with an
older podman-machine-os image.

The podman-machine-os PR makes still sense for users that are creating a
new podman machine with a podman client with version <= v6.1.3.

Signed-off-by: Mario Loriedo <mario.loriedo@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit b420cc6ca7567f5ac418ad7535cdfd9ab4c7bec4)
```

```    
Fix config file mounting in WSL for usernames with spaces

Signed-off-by: Mario Loriedo <mario.loriedo@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit 3704166a5e08da967a6956b4b9059a6a87a1c1f5)
```
